newsitem.title: USA: Tengasco wins leasing rights judgment.
newsitem.headline: Tengasco wins leasing rights judgment.

text.p: Tengasco Inc said on Tuesday it won a summary judgment against Eastern American Energy Corp for drilling lease rights to 647 acres of land in Hancock County, Tennessee.
Eastern American had held a drilling lease for the property, but under Tennessee law, it had to begin production from wells to renew the lease beyond 10 years, Tengasco said in a statement.
Tengasco said a court ruled Eastern's lease was no longer valid because it had not met this requirement.
Rights reverted back to landowners Paul and Lucille Reed, who leased the property and well to Tengasco, it said.
Tengasco said the lease was important to the completion of a 23-mile gas pipeline it was constructing.
The defendents filed affidavits which said they spent about $3.4 million to drill and complete the well, Tengasco said.
